name: Mask of Madness
description:
Active: Berserk

Gives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you. Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.\n\n

Passive: Lifesteal

Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.
lore: Once this mask is worn, its bearer becomes an uncontrollable aggressive force.
